scope: Exactly eight saved D1390 screenshots in one bounded batch: desktop and mobile whole-course, opening-viewport and fig42/43 captures. Visible English layout and current English applicability of unchanged generated fig42 PNG and deterministic fig43 SVG at actual media widths 640 and 358. Text/science PASS is reused, not replayed.
verdict: The eight inspected captures support PASS for this bounded offline saved-display/context scope. No exact observed overlap, horizontal clipping, broken media, unreadable Nozzle label or English-context incompatibility requires revision. This is not complete English accessibility, headed acceptance, source reapproval, every-glyph certification or full-course/publication approval.

bindingAssessment.method: Read the actual recovered native/display/width reports once, verify named input and screenshot SHA256 bytes with shasum, compare current lesson/context JSON with jq, and inspect exactly eight existing screenshots via functions.view_image. No checker, browser, renderer or native producer executed.
bindingAssessment.projection: One grouped ALL row, including captions and empty figure placeholders, not p-only or heading-free context.
bindingAssessment.widthDerivativeDisposition: These are the D1372 width-bound derivative specs linked to recovered D1389 native assets. They add actual mobile width 358 to the explicit contract while retaining the exact approved PNG/SVG bytes and complete English context. They are not a new render or a rewrite of original Chinese specs.
bindingAssessment.historicalWhitespaceDisposition: The previously disclosed historical grouped-ALL Chinese whitespace mismatch remains historical. Exact current English context-to-lesson equality does not recover exact reviewed Chinese template bytes or grant Chinese science approval.

savedViewEvidence.assessment: The centered English reading column has clear heading/body spacing, distinct paragraph blocks and two unobstructed concept separators. Equations visible in the opening capture are separate from surrounding prose and do not collide with their labels. Both figures and their English captions remain within the column; later text continues below the figures rather than overlapping them.

The title, breadcrumb, prose and equations wrap within the narrow column with stable side margins. Both portrait-format figures fit without horizontal loss; English captions and subsequent paragraphs remain separate. No visible clipped word, merged paragraph, caption collision or broken graphic was observed. The opening viewport naturally ends partway through continuing prose; the whole-course capture shows its continuation.

imageAssessments.assessment: The whole saved lesson is nonblank and follows one coherent reading column from title through the final paragraph. Both figures, captions, safety paragraphs and conceptual separators are visible without gross overlap or clipping. The repeated chapter wording in the breadcrumb remains readable and wraps without colliding with the title; it is not treated as a new source/identity defect.
imageAssessments.limit: Tall-preview gross-layout inspection, not independent certification of every word, fine glyph or mathematical sign.

imageAssessments.assessment: The Adiabatic processes heading and opening prose are visibly English and readable. Delta U equations, equation identifiers and inline Q are distinguishable, with adequate separation from neighboring lines. The retained polarization filename is a helper naming artifact; the image is the N26 opening viewport, not a different lesson.

The upright transparent cylinder, piston, rod/handle, two hands and lower cotton-like material are clearly distinguishable. The apparatus is not stretched, blanked or cut off by the display container. No instructional text or cultural/source-language lettering is visibly introduced into this generated raster.

The Nozzle label and its plain identification leader are readable and separated. The central injector, dotted spray region, side valve/spring structures, piston and lower connecting-rod features are visible. No container-edge clipping, blank SVG or label-to-diagram collision is observed.

English prose wraps through the full tall reading surface with consistent side margins, paragraph spacing and separators. Both complete figures and Figure 42/43 captions fit inside the column. Safety text and the revised Diesel sentence are present in the expected later blocks; this is visual presence only, not replayed science approval.
imageAssessments.limit: The very tall capture supports complete-surface gross-layout observations, not every-character readability or all-glyph certification.

imageAssessments.assessment: The heading fits on one line, the English breadcrumb wraps, and opening prose remains readable without horizontal clipping. The visible Delta U = Q equation and its identifier are separated. The partially visible bottom line is normal viewport continuation rather than evidence of lost lesson text. This retained filename also contains polarization but shows N26.

The transparent cylinder, piston/rod, pressing hand, supporting hand and material near the bottom remain distinguishable at the actual 358-pixel width. The portrait aspect ratio is preserved and the apparatus is not horizontally clipped. No new label or measurement is needed to interpret its unchanged apparatus role.

Nozzle remains visibly readable, with a separated leader to the central injector. The main valves, passages, spray, piston bands and lower rod/eye silhouette are distinguishable at mobile width and stay within the image. Fine linework is smaller than on desktop; this observation does not certify every tiny stroke or source-inventory count.

preservedFailures.disposition: Preserved wrapper binds the original failed native receipt and failed English spec. Retired generated-artwork scratch paths were the execution cause; D1389 recovers the affected asset-path/native stage, not a failed science or source gate.

Preserved pre-native mixed-mode helper failure: generated-only assets restoration was incorrectly applied to deterministic fig43. Recovered per-asset dispatch does not convert fig43 to generated mode or establish any new content approval.

Preserved English-ARIA expectation failure. D1390 accepts and discloses retained Chinese source identities for ARIA/alt while visible captions and Nozzle are English. This changes the bounded evidence expectation, not the accessibility language itself; complete English accessibility remains unapproved.

limits.tallPreviewLimit: Whole-course screenshots are very tall and may be scaled by the viewing tool. They support gross layout/continuity and figure-placement observations, not independent every-character legibility. The two existing opening viewports and four existing figure captures supply closer observations only for their visible regions; no other crops or reopens were authorized.
limits.fineGlyphLimit: Nozzle is the single specifically measured SVG label, with Arial platform-font evidence for six glyphs. This is not proof that every mathematical glyph, unused font face, tiny schematic stroke or possible embedded raster marking is independently certified. Original fine source-fidelity review is reused without source reopening.
limits.ariaLimit: Saved DOM evidence deliberately retains Chinese source figure identities in ARIA and fig42 alt text. These are not visibly printed Chinese captions. No screen-reader test or complete-English-accessibility pass is inferred.
limits.surfaceLimit: The saved D1390 surfaces are isolated offline headless HTML previews, not the running headed or production product. Actual 640/358 measurements apply to these surfaces only.
